traits.name: Superior Darkvision
traits.desc: You have Darkvision with a range of 120 feet.

traits.name: Drow Cantrip
traits.desc: You know the Dancing Lights cantrip.

traits.name: Lineage: Faerie Fire
traits.desc: Starting at level 3, you always have Faerie Fire prepared; you can cast it once per Long Rest without a spell slot.

traits.name: Lineage: Darkness
traits.desc: Starting at level 5, you always have Darkness prepared; you can cast it once per Long Rest without a spell slot.
